Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
I have two examples of cards I never wanted to play before, both in
Necromancy, and that became nice with Bloodlines, more precisely with the
Harbingers :
Soul Stealing (for the girl who burns weenies and the one who burns
uncontrolled), and Grasp the Ghostly (more chances to get your prey to
discard a nice weapon...).

Oh, and Haunts were only so-so, but every Harbinger deck with
Slaughterhouses ought to have some !!

Other examples / ideas ?

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:


I forgot Deal with the Devil, which was always better with Necromancy in
case you had a nice one among the rest, but that's much better now that you
can replace your combat discards with your opponent's (what if they play no
discipline you do ? DEAL !!).

As an aside : what are the ways to discard quickly except vampire special
powers, the Barrens, the Cel card and the Deal ?

--
Yours,
